evals.expected_output: Writes a plain-English capitalized imperative title with the Automata co-author trailer.
evals.prompt: Commit my StorageClass fix in shikanime-studio/manifests with the right message style.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-commit'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body specifies a 'Co-authored-by: Automata <automata@shikanime.studio>' trailer
Body requires a plain-English capitalized imperative title with no conventional prefix
Body shows a 'jj describe' command with two -m blocks

evals.expected_output: Strips squash artifacts so the final message is one subject plus correct trailers.
evals.prompt: I squashed three commits and the message is full of bullet points and dashes — fix it before I merge.
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-commit'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body says to strip '*' bullet lines and '---------' separators from squashed messages
Body allows exactly one Automata Co-authored-by trailer
Body limits Signed-off-by to repos whose hook requires DCO

evals.expected_output: Detects repo-enforced hooks such as gitlint or commitlint and obeys them over the defaults.
evals.prompt: gitlint rejected my commit in the manifests repo — what does that repo actually require?
assertions: YAML frontmatter parses and 'name' equals 'sks-commit'
Frontmatter description starts with 'Use when' and is at most 200 characters
Frontmatter license field is 'Apache-2.0'
Body contains at least one '##' heading
Body states repo-enforced hooks always win over the default style
Body requires full issue URLs in 'Related:' instead of bare #N
Body mentions detecting .gitlint or commitlint config
